posture: The persons research registers the Population bonsai grows from: every row of each Identity workbook's agents sheet as the workbook holds it, five cells of every row of its works sheet (ID, labels, dates, responsibility), the authors table's sheets (registry/, written by intake.py), and the same agent rows parsed into one shape (layer/, written by parse.py). Kept in R2 under docs/STORAGE.md; git holds this digest manifest only. `node bonsai/lib/layers.mjs fetch bonsai/review/population` brings the files into a checkout.
